description: Five supplied furniture concepts, A and B variants, ten static game props.

signage.geometry: Each SignFace has four vertices and two triangles. No text mesh or font object.
signage.edit: Replace the Base Map on Materials/InformationBoard_A.mat or InformationBoard_B.mat. Duplicate the material first for independent signage.
signage.copy: Sample hall directions. Adjust these textures to the final game layout.

contents: Bookcase Contents meshes are separate from Body meshes; remove Contents for empty shelving, updating both LOD levels.
animation: Static set dressing. Wheels, doors and drawers are not rigged.

materials.custom: Sign artwork, printed book spines, leaf accents and green desktop inset were authored for this pack. The marble patch uses the downloaded BlenderKit Green marble base-color texture.
